1.12.section: peer comparison: member table, composite or refusal, survivorship, heterogeneity
1.12.source: the benchmark selection record (Blackstone Private Credit Fund)
1.12.value: Peer comparison (paragraphs (g) and (h)): private credit cohort, peers Cliffwater Corporate Lending Fund, PIMCO Flexible Credit Income Fund, CION Ares Diversified Credit Fund, Blue Owl Credit Income Corp., fund return basis filed calendar-year returns (December fiscal year). Equal-weight peer composite over 2021 to 2025 (n=4 peers in every period, identical start and end dates): relative wealth ratio 1.0986 = fund growth 1.5998x / composite growth 1.4562x, annualized excess return +1.9%/yr (fund 9.85%/yr vs composite 7.81%/yr). Not a public market equivalent: the peer composite is appraisal-based, constructed by the evaluator and cannot be bought. Alignment: 5 calendar-year period(s) with identical start and end dates for every member (2020-12-31 to 2025-12-31), n=4 peers in every period. Member return sources: Cliffwater Corporate Lending Fund: Yahoo adjusted close, approximates NAV total return; PIMCO Flexible Credit Income Fund: Yahoo adjusted close, approximates NAV total return; CION Ares Diversified Credit Fund: Yahoo adjusted close, approximates NAV total return; Blue Owl Credit Income Corp.: filed calendar-year returns (December fiscal year). Side by side, every period any member reports, columns in this order: Cliffwater Corporate Lending Fund, PIMCO Flexible Credit Income Fund, CION Ares Diversified Credit Fund, Blue Owl Credit Income Corp., Blackstone Private Credit Fund. n = members reporting. 2018 (n=2): n/a / 2.86% / 4.45% / n/a / n/a | 2019 (n=2): n/a / 10.63% / 9.5% / n/a / n/a | 2020 (n=3): 5.39% / 4.29% / 2.79% / n/a / n/a | 2021 (n=5): 10.38% / 11.29% / 9.21% / 4.3% / 12.6% | 2022 (n=5): 2.05% / -15.36% / -2.85% / 5.2% / 3.6% | 2023 (n=5): 12.66% / 9.25% / 12.99% / 13.5% / 14.4% | 2024 (n=5): 12.62% / 15.27% / 10.39% / 11.5% / 11% | 2025 (n=5): 8.92% / 12.2% / 7.69% / 7.9% / 8%. The cohort is the roster's 5 surviving, still-filing products. Funds that closed, merged, or stopped filing are not in it, so any composite carries survivorship bias in the fund's favor. Membership rationales and exclusions are in the roster record. Members span 2 wrapper types (interval fund (Rule 23c-3), non-traded BDC) and 2 leverage regimes (1940-Act asset-coverage limits, BDC 150% asset-coverage regime). Fee bases, leverage and exit rights are not like-for-like, so the comparison is a history of similar investments, not a like-for-like index.
